name: Chobble Tickets
shortDescription: A UK-built open-source event-ticketing and check-in platform for paid or free events, registrations, donations and equipment hire, with managed or self-hosted deployment.
suitableContexts: Churches, circuits or charities running paid or free events
Teams that want ticket revenue paid directly to their own Stripe, Square or SumUp account
Organisations that value an open-source, self-hostable event platform

pricing.summary: Managed hosting is published at £5 per month or £50 per year, with a stated 50% annual discount for charities, community groups, artists and musicians. Chobble states that it does not charge a per-ticket platform fee; payment-processor charges still apply.

startingPrice.qualifier: Managed hosting; payment-processor fees are separate

tiers.label: Managed hosting
tiers.detail: Unlimited events and tickets; no stated platform commission

tiers.label: Managed hosting annually
tiers.detail: Supplier states charities and community groups receive 50% off the annual price

tiers.label: Self-hosted
tiers.detail: AGPL-3.0 software; the organisation owns hosting, payment and operations

dataHosting: For managed hosting, the supplier states that attendee data is encrypted at rest and kept in EU regions on Bunny.net infrastructure in Slovenia. Self-hosting location, processors and operations are chosen by the organisation. Confirm the current data-processing agreement and payment-provider data flows for a particular event.
gdprInformation: Chobble identifies itself as a UK ICO-registered controller for managed-hosting attendee data and describes UK/EU data handling. These are supplier statements, not a compliance assessment for an organiser, which remains responsible for its event privacy information and processing decisions.
coreFeatures: Attendee questions, capacity and booking windows
integrations: Stripe, Square or SumUp for organiser-owned payments
Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes
importExport: Supplier states that operational and financial data can be exported
Self-hosted deployment gives the organisation direct control of its data and deployment
support: Managed-hosting support is included according to the supplier
Self-hosting requires the organisation to own technical support

uk-purchasing.value: Chobble CIC is a UK community-interest company, number 17050113, and publishes managed hosting prices in GBP.

gbp-pricing.value: Supplier publishes £5/month or £50/year managed hosting, with no per-ticket platform fee stated.

hosting.value: Supplier states that managed-hosting attendee data is encrypted at rest and kept in EU regions on Bunny.net infrastructure in Slovenia.

exports.value: Supplier describes operational and financial data exports, an API and a self-hosted option.

editorial.assessment: Chobble Tickets is a credible UK event-ticketing choice for churches that need more control than a marketplace platform but do not need a full church-management system. Its low flat managed-hosting price, organiser-owned payment accounts and open-source route are distinctive. The trade-off is that it is general event software, so a church must test its own registration, safeguarding, Gift Aid and volunteer check-in workflows rather than assume those needs are covered.
bestFor: Church events, conferences, workshops and paid registrations
Organisations wanting direct payment-provider ownership and no stated platform commission
Technically capable teams that may prefer self-hosting or API integration
strengths: Clear GBP managed-hosting pricing and a free self-hosted option
UK CIC identity, ICO registration reference and detailed supplier data-location information
Broad ticketing, registration, refund, check-in, API and export functionality
limitations: Not designed specifically for church administration, Gift Aid or safeguarding workflows
Managed hosting uses EU rather than UK-only infrastructure according to the supplier
Self-hosting shifts security, support, updates and incident responsibilities to the church or its technical partner

procurementVerdict.problem: Running church events without marketplace-style ticket commissions or surrendering payment-account ownership
procurementVerdict.differentiator: Open-source ticketing with managed or self-hosted deployment and direct Stripe, Square or SumUp payments
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run a real registration and check-in scenario, then confirm payment fees, data-processing terms, refund controls and the organisation's support responsibility
